note: Master layout for one church: WHAT happens in its services, never HOW. The binding profile for the presentation app (kit/templates/bindings/) says how. No lyrics, no passwords, no hosts, no program commands in this file. Copy to <church_root>\layout.json and edit. A graphic has one entry per binding profile, `graphics.<id>.<profile> = {"via": ..., ...}`. Its `via` is a name defined by that profile: it must exist in that profile as `show_graphic.<via>` (and `clear_graphic.<via>` if a service clears it); it need not exist in any other profile. `hint` is a via every binding profile has implicitly: it shows the operator the graphic's name and never sends anything, so use `hint` when the app has nothing else. A graphic with no entry for the active profile falls back to `hint`, and `voxxad --check-layout` prints a warning, not an error. A key that exists in the profile runs only after its contract test passes; until then the driver turns it into a hint (ADR-024 § 5).

presenter.note: One of: keystroke.worshiptools_presenter, keystroke.universal, propresenter7_rest, freeshow, openlp_v2, opensong. Changing app = changing this one field: a graphic with no entry for the new app degrades to a hint.

cues.label: Prayer card
cues.note: Phrases are 2 to 8 words, letters only, matched in order. A cue is armed only inside a spoken service item that lists it, never during a song. Auto mode needs the proven-safe bar and a typed confirm; leave it at suggest.

defaults.note: Modes: auto (voxxa does it), suggest (voxxa shows a card; the operator accepts), off. A service plan may lower these, never raise them.

hotkeys.note: Global keys work while Songs is on, even with the presentation app in front. F13-F19 are for a foot pedal, Stream Deck or Companion (no keyboard has them). No hotkey stops listening or turns voxxa off.

keyboard_hotkeys.note: Optional keyboard keys, registered only after voxxa checks no other program uses them. Never Ctrl+Alt+arrows (they rotate the screen on some PCs). Leave this off with WorshipTools Presenter: F6 to F9 are Presenter's own keys (Countdown, Alert, Media Library, Stage Display alert), and a voxxa hotkey would take them away from it while Songs is on.
